confidence_notes: The FX figure comes from the RBA page search, which reported 0.6720 USD per AUD for 18 November 2026. I ran one food and drink search, and it returned crowdsourced cost-of-living sites with a wide spread of prices, mostly dated 2023-2025. Restaurant meals and coffee are reasonably supported: inexpensive meals cluster around $3.50-4.50 and cappuccino around $3-4. Beer is a restaurant or pub estimate, based on bar prices of RMB 40-80 and a pub-pint figure of about RMB 44. Cocktail and wine were not found directly. I set them from the local relationship to bar beer prices, with cocktails at about 2.5-3 times beer and wine at about 2 times beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for Suzhou and are not based on any listing or booking-page check. They are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Suzhou is a wealthy Yangtze River Delta tourist city next to Shanghai. Its prices are a little below Shanghai and similar to Hangzhou or Nanjing.
